sources.title: The No-Report Paradigm: A Revolution in Consciousness Research?
sources.quality_notes: Systematic critical review; no new experimental data; logic-based critique; identifies genuine methodological limitations

sources.title: A higher-order theory of emotional consciousness
sources.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
sources.quality_notes: PNAS; LeDoux is a leading authority on fear/emotion neuroscience; conceptual paper; GNC mechanism details remain theoretical

sources.title: Distinguishing the Neural Correlates of Perceptual Awareness and Postperceptual Processing
sources.quality_notes: Experimental study; Bayesian analyses support null hypothesis; N=20 is modest; needs multi-lab replication; pre-registered analysis

sources.title: Isolating neural correlates of conscious perception from neural correlates of reporting one's perception
sources.quality_notes: Frontiers in Psychology; seminal no-report EEG paper; VAN as consciousness NCC candidate; results align with later Cohen 2020

sources.title: The neural correlates of dreaming
covers: fusiform face area for face dreams
sources.quality_notes: Nature Neuroscience; Tononi group (IIT); closed-loop real-time prediction design; strongest available no-report NCC evidence; post-hoc reports may miss dream content

sources.title: Empirical support for higher-order theories of conscious awareness
covers: HOT vs FOT vs GWT vs RPT distinctions
sources.quality_notes: Trends in Cognitive Sciences; Lau is a leading HOT theorist; abstract only read

sources.title: Understanding the higher-order approach to consciousness
sources.quality_notes: Trends in Cognitive Sciences; comprehensive HOT review; abstract only read
